title: Parametric Box Body
summary: Use a centered rectangle sketch and blind extrude for robot bodies, housings, and simple block geometry.
parameterHints: Expose width, height, and depth as editable length parameters.
Use a fillet radius parameter only if a rounded edge is explicitly requested.
modelingNotes: Sketch the base profile on a selectable plane with newSketchOnPlane.
Keep the rectangle centered around the origin so later mirrors and mating are easier.
example_prompt: Robot body 12 inches wide, 6 inches tall, 4 inches deep with 0.25 inch fillets

title: Bushing Or Sleeve
summary: Model bushings and spacers as concentric circles extruded to length.
parameterHints: Expose outer radius, inner radius, and length.
Validate that inner radius stays smaller than outer radius.
modelingNotes: Use one sketch with two concentric circles and extrude the ring region.
Prefer editable radii over hardcoded diameters in the body.
example_prompt: Bushing with 0.75 inch outer diameter, 0.5 inch inner diameter, and 1 inch length

title: Linkage Arm
summary: Use a centered bar sketch with end holes for train linkages, couplers, and lever arms.
parameterHints: Expose total length, bar width, thickness, and pin hole radius.
Compute hole offset from total length and hole size to preserve end material.
modelingNotes: Create the outer rectangle and end holes in the same sketch.
Keep holes symmetric unless the prompt explicitly requests asymmetry.
example_prompt: Linkage arm 5 inches long, 1 inch wide, 0.25 inch thick with 0.2 inch pin holes

title: Flange With Bolt Circle
summary: Model circular flanges with a bore and evenly patterned bolt holes.
parameterHints: Expose outer radius, bore radius, hole radius, hole count, and thickness.
If bolt circle diameter is not given, use a derived radius around 70 to 80 percent of outer radius.
modelingNotes: Generate all circles in one sketch before extruding.
Evenly distribute bolt holes using cosine and sine from the center.
example_prompt: Round flange 4 inch OD with 1 inch bore and 4 bolt holes

title: L Bracket
summary: Use a simple 2D L profile extruded to length for angle brackets and corner supports.
parameterHints: Expose arm width, arm height, wall thickness, and extrusion length.
Keep wall thickness smaller than both arm dimensions.
modelingNotes: Sketch a closed L profile instead of extruding a full plate and cutting it afterward.
Use simple straight segments for reliability.
example_prompt: L bracket 3 inches by 4 inches, 0.25 inch wall, 2 inch long

title: Hitch Peg Or Mushroom Pin
summary: Model a pin with a cylindrical shaft and domed or revolved head.
parameterHints: Expose shaft radius, shaft height, and head radius.
If head height is not provided, approximate a rounded cap from the head radius.
modelingNotes: Create the shaft with a cylinder-like operation and the head with a revolve profile.
Union the head and shaft at the end.
example_prompt: Hitch peg with 0.25 inch shaft diameter, 0.5 inch shaft height, and 0.42 inch dome head

title: Spur Gear
summary: Use an involute-inspired 2D tooth profile and extrude it to face width for train gears and pinions.
parameterHints: Expose tooth count and face width; derive pitch geometry from pitch radius or diametral pitch.
Add a bore radius parameter when the gear must mount to a shaft.
modelingNotes: Keep pressure angle at 20 degrees unless the prompt requests otherwise.
Prefer a valid simplified gear profile over an overcomplicated but brittle one.
example_prompt: 20 tooth spur gear with 2 inch pitch diameter and 0.5 inch face width

title: Slotted Mounting Plate
summary: For adjustable mounts, use a plate profile with one or more slots instead of only round holes.
parameterHints: Expose plate width, plate height, thickness, slot length, slot width, and slot spacing.
If the prompt is ambiguous, use centered slots with enough margin to the outer edge.
modelingNotes: Build each slot from two circles connected by tangent lines in the same sketch.
Extrude the resulting sketch region with the slot cutouts already present.
example_prompt: Mounting plate 6 by 3 inches with two 1.5 inch slots
